name: linuxcnc-node
description: Native gRPC services and TypeScript contracts for LinuxCNC

scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.check:contracts: pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/types check:generated && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/grpc-client check:generated && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/websocket-client check:generated
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/types test:conformance && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/grpc-client test:conformance && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/websocket-client test
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/types build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/grpc-client build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/websocket-client build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:consumers
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/types build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/grpc-client build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/websocket-client build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/hal-inspector typecheck
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/types build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/grpc-client build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/websocket-client build && pnpm --filter @linuxcnc-node/hal-inspector build

author: Dariusz Majnert
